annotations.title: Leave rows out of the totals, or count them again

description: Leave transactions out of every total — **a list of ids in one call** — or count them again with `excluded: false`. A row left out stays in the ledger and is shown marked; it is simply not summed. This is what the Transactions screen’s row menu does: a card bill the bank statement shows as one charge is the same money as the card statement’s rows, and counting both doubles the month. **Dry-runs by default** and says how much it would take off the totals; commit with `commit: true` after the user has said yes. The document is copied to a timestamped .bak first. Ids come from `transactions`.

commit.description: Default false. False previews and writes nothing; true makes the change.

excluded.description: Default true: leave them out. False counts them in the totals again.

path.description: Absolute path to a .emd file on this machine.
